sentence: This project builds a CRISPR genome editing tool that removes the mutant allele causing frontotemporal dementia, in human cells and mice.
This project builds an automated tape-based electron tomography system to image the brain at large scale and map neuronal circuits.
This project builds AI tools that use real-world data to improve how renal masses are diagnosed and managed.
This project studies how breast cancer treatment changes biological aging and physical function in cancer survivors over time.
This project builds an imaging system to help study radiopharmaceutical therapy, a method of treating cancer.
This project maps enhancers, pieces of the human genome that turn genes on and off, in Kaposi sarcoma tumor tissue from patients.
This project studies genomic data from people of different ancestries and environments to make genomic discoveries about cancer prevention and treatment more accurate.
This project studies molecules made by bacteria that may work together with an immune checkpoint inhibitor to treat lung cancer.
This project uses mathematical modeling to test whether rapid tests for recent HIV infection help reach epidemic goals and use limited resources well.
This project tests a trauma-focused treatment for adolescents who have both substance use disorders and post-traumatic stress disorder.
This project studies how a maternal respiratory syncytial virus vaccine protects mothers and infants, including antibodies passed through the placenta and breastmilk.
This project tries to find out what role the gut-brain axis plays in the harm cadmium does to the brain.
This project builds cartilage for airway reconstruction from donor meniscus cleared of cells and refilled with a patient's own cells.
This project tests whether MRI analysis tied to race can reduce racial differences in prostate cancer diagnosis.
This project tests how amyloid precursor protein is related to mitochondria and mitophagy in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how the protein Tau makes lysosomes fail in human neuronal models of frontotemporal dementia.
This project uses natural language processing to find patterns in clinical documentation and tests if they relate to outcomes for pregnant women and newborns.
This project builds RNA-based vectors that deliver a Prime Editor system to cells, aiming at gene therapy for sickle cell disease.
This project gives vision researchers help with analyzing clinical and genetic data, including whole-genome sequencing.
This project develops a small molecule drug that stimulates a receptor to treat dementia caused by diseases of small blood vessels in the brain.
